capabilities: Preview clicked files in a modal with Obsidian's native view header
Open files normally in the editor via Cmd/Ctrl-click
Capture internal links inside the modal and open them in place
Configure the trigger modifier and hide workspace or sidebar UI elements
Register an 'Open in modal' file-menu entry as a fallback
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README documents a technical limitation: it relies on the unofficial data-path DOM attribute of file explorer items, with the file-menu entry kept as a fallback if that breaks.
intentEvidence: opens files from the file explorer in a modal preview instead of in the editor
problem: Clicking a file in the file explorer always opens it in the main editor, which disrupts the current workspace layout when you just want to peek at a file.

relations.evidence: wikilink completion, Templater, the native read/edit toggle) keeps working inside the modal

summary: File-explorer modifier that opens clicked files in an 80% viewport modal preview instead of the editor.
